scenes.title: Showrig
scenes.tagline: A director's wizard for films made offline
lines: This film was made by Showrig, from a handful of answers and a storyboard.

scenes.title: Answer the questions
scenes.subtitle: showrig new my-film
lines: You answer a director's questions: the kind of film, the look, the voice and the music.
Showrig writes a storyboard you can read, sign off and edit by hand.

scenes.title: Then it is procedural
lines: After sign-off, every step runs on your own computer.

scenes.title: One command
scenes.subtitle: showrig make my-film
lines: One command records the screens, voices the script, renders the 3D stage in Blender and the titles in EffectCraft.
It ends in an editable FilmCraft project and a finished render.

scenes.title: Showrig
scenes.tagline: Your answers in, a finished film out
lines: Credits, voices and shots can all be swapped later.
